blocks.x: don't want to miss anything that was happening there but the big thing - well of course, what you did do was, you made yourself at home in a dozen places like the Hyatt-Regency in New Orleans; like Disneyworld; and of course, always the Cookery; and then when you came out here you'd play what?
Well I played at Concerts by the Sea, the Lighthouse, and then I did a concert at U.C.L.A..
And Max Cavalli was booking you in different places, wasn't he?
Yeah, like I'd go to Canada.
Yeah, what would you play up in Toronto?
Oh, and then would you go to Montreal?
But then I'd go to Sandy's Place.
